rationale: Several papers contribute substantive new evidence on how the environments of fast radio bursts, including host galaxies and surrounding media, influence their observed properties. Papers 2309.07751 and 2608.27779 discuss dispersion measures related to host galaxies, while 2305.11477 and 2506.23403 explore scattering and correlations with host properties. Paper 2608.23868 examines the relationship between host dispersion measure and stellar mass.
